name: Tetragonal Crystal
description: v1's Tetragonal Crystal: a 25×25 square lattice (spacing 500) of neutral atoms (6 up + 6 down quarks, 2 electrons), nuclear charge ±1 in a checkerboard, under v1's powAX nuclear force (range 1000) and Coulomb, inside a reflecting circle of radius 5e4. Gravity (G = 1e-3) is negligible and omitted.
